description: Telecommunication subscribers by service in Jordan is a series of data sets listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Telecommunications Regulatory Commission. Number of subscribers in Internet services: The indicator includes the total number of fixed narrowed and broadband subscribers and the total number of mobile broadband subscribers. An updated version is published for each year on the following fiscal year. Coverage: Jordan. The portal lists 23 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Telecommunications Regulatory Commission. Its tags are Internet services, Number of subscribers, subscribers. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, XLS, XML. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
